name: section3
purpose: Frozen-surface convergence for the paper's sections 3 and 4.

resolution_parameterization.rule: h = c / n, with c = 0.090 m and integer n
why: c = R - delta/2 is the distance from a sphere centre to the contact
plane at this penetration, so h = c/n places the plane an exact integer
number of cells from the centre.

measured: The affine (plane_clip) contact plane sits 19n/9 cells from the
sphere grid's lower bound. Because 19 = 1 (mod 9), the fractional part
is exactly (n mod 9)/9. A fractional part of 0 puts the plane on a cell
boundary and the force error jumps 5x to 20x.
Verified against 18 measured rungs at delta = 20 mm: n = 9, 18, 36, 45,
A separate sweep at fixed h located the same defect as a razor-narrow
spike whenever (R - delta/2)/h is a half-integer: predicted delta =
15.5 and 24.5 mm at h = 4.5 mm before running, and both spiked to 7.7
and 6.6 percent while +-0.05 mm either side stayed near 0.4 percent.
Only sphere_sphere is affected. On sphere_box the equal-pressure
surface is a paraboloid, so different radii cross different cell
boundaries out of phase and the error averages out; its errors fall
monotonically from 16 percent to 0.02 percent with no anomaly.
Marching cubes interpolates across cells and shows no phase effect.
Every n below satisfies the rule, in both scenes and for all three
representations, so no rung sits on the defect.

matched_h.what: Every representation at the same h. Answers convergence order.
matched_h.note: Span 7.6x. Same n for all three representations.

what: Per-representation h chosen so contact-element counts land near 10,
1e2, 1e3 and 1e4. Answers accuracy per unit of solver work.
Counts are approximate by design: n is constrained to the clean-phase
set, and Drake's tetrahedral mesher is quantized -- it returns the
same mesh across ranges of resolution hint, so tet cannot be tuned to
an arbitrary count. Actual counts are recorded per run.
note: tet floors near 70 faces on sphere_box even at h = 45 mm, so the
10-element rung is only reachable by the voxel representations there.

supersedes: Both used n = 9, 18, 36, 72, i.e. n = 0 (mod 9) at every rung, so every
affine sphere_sphere point sat on the cell-boundary defect. Their
affine numbers for that scene should not be quoted.
